Let \(S_n=\sum_{k=1}^n a_k=\frac{2^n-1}{8}\).

The reciprocal sum is
\[
\sum_{k=1}^n \frac1{a_k}
=\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{8}{2^{k-1}}
=8\sum_{r=0}^{n-1}\left(\frac12\right)^r
=16\left(1-2^{-n}\right).
\]

We need
\[
\frac{2^n-1}{8}\le 16(1-2^{-n}).
\]
Let \(x=2^n\). Then
\[
x-1\le 128-\frac{128}{x}
\]
\[
x^2-129x+128\le 0
\]
\[
(x-1)(x-128)\le 0.
\]
Since \(x=2^n>1\), this gives \(x\le 128\), so \(2^n\le 2^7\). Thus \(n\le 7\).

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
